_approach: Sub-Zero-style minimal techno: a four-to-the-floor kick, a layered brushy/snappy hi-hat pair, an 808 snare on 2 and 4 with a ghost snare right before each downbeat, and a rolling 16th shaker bed that (with the 60% swing) gives the 'jacking' feel Attack's Sub-Zero Minimal Techno dissection describes. Robert Hood's Minimal Nation ethos applies underneath: strip everything to what the groove needs, nothing else.
